title: Upgrade: v1.6.0-personalized-feeds
summary: v1.6 Personalized Feeds: Home feed with tier-weighted vote scores, Following feed for subscribed users/topics. Single topic per post (removes cross-posting), max_cross_posts removed from tiers, mint_interval 20->200 blocks (10 min), max_topic_size 50->35, max_username_size 40->30, content/title limits count Unicode characters.
